newsitem.title: CHINA: Great Wall Computer says seeks Hong Kong listing.
newsitem.headline: Great Wall Computer says seeks Hong Kong listing.

text.p: China Great Wall Computer Group Corp confirmed on Monday it has filed an application with Chinese regulatory authorities to list shares on the Hong Kong stock exchange.

The company is still waiting for approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission and has not yet determined how many shares would be offered to the public, an official in the company's finance department told Reuters.

The listing would follow a reorganisation of the group with the possible formation of a new company, expected to be called China Great Wall Technology Corp Ltd, to be registered in Shenzhen in southern China.
The new company would include Great Wall's computer hardware and software operations and would be at least 51 percent owned by China Great Wall Computer Group.

The company produces computer software as well as personal computers, printers and other computer hardware. It has 17 subsidiaries and has cooperation agreements with IBM Corp and Microsoft Corp, according to Great Wall officials.
It also provides computer software used in financial services.
